decisions.reason: This low-cost accessory builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how and supports after-sales revenue, though it went unobserved in 2020 to 2021 and could quietly fold into the general accessory range.
The box trailer series is the firm's core competence, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the models, making continuation likely despite possible model updates.

Car transporters extend existing chassis and axle expertise into a professional niche the firm can assimilate through its dealer network, but the smaller segment carries moderate risk of the range being trimmed.
The low-bed series rests closely on established trailer design and production skills and was featured prominently, so the firm is well placed to keep developing it.
High covers complement the box trailers using familiar materials and processes and sell through existing channels, which makes them easy to maintain and improve.
This second box trailer series fits core know-how, but its overlap with Product B raises the risk of consolidation, so it is kept with elevated uncertainty.
